story: Del Norte Coast Redwoods State Park is a forest located in California, United States. Originally established in 1925, the park is now 126.5 km2 and includes miles of wild Pacific coastline. It is about half old-growth forest of coast redwoods.
matters: The park is a component of the Redwood National and State Parks. It was designated part of the California Coast Ranges International Biosphere Reserve.
name: Del Norte Coast Redwoods State Park
